key_reasoning.reason: About 9 modified files and 0 new across two repos: backend user_repository, user_management_service and user_management_router (docstrings and Query descriptions), the OpenAPI baseline and test_user_repository_sort; frontend ProjectMembersManager, the user store, ProjectMembersOrdering.test and user.test. Most edits are a few lines or deletions.

Repository query default plus sort map, docs-only edits in the service and router, and on the UI side the user store and the Members tab component, split across the codemie and codemie-ui repos. There is no shared contract change because the explicit sort_by/sort_order API stays the same, so this is not cross-system scope.
Persistence query (no schema change), Service and API (docs/OpenAPI descriptions) and UI (store and page). That is the standard full-stack path with no migration.

The closest pattern is EPMCDME-16070's _SORT_COLUMN_MAP and SQL-string ORDER BY tests (also mirrored in application_repository). This task reuses it with less code. There is no security-sensitive surface. The risks are procedural: the OpenAPI baseline regeneration needs a careful diff review on an already-failing snapshot, and the default order visibly changes for the Users Management page and SDK consumers.

Total 14 sits on the 14/15 S/M boundary. It leans lower per the borderline rule: Technical Risk is S and the existing patterns cover nearly all of the work. This agrees with bundled S example epmcdme-10102. The file count is higher here only because two repos and their tests are touched.
